title: LiteEvent-AE: Lightweight Autoencoder for Event-Based Vision on Low-Latency Energy-Constrained Edge Devices
abstract: arXiv:2608.21764v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Event-based vision has emerged as a promising paradigm for energy-aware artificial intelligence (AI), offering sparse, low-latency visual signals that reduce redundant data processing and support sustainable edge computing. However, the asynchronous and noise-prone nature of event streams creates challenges for conventional deep learning models, which are often too computationally intensive for low-power embedded platforms. This work presents a compact and configurable event-driven autoencoder that efficiently compresses neuromorphic data while preserving essential spatiotemporal structure for downstream inference. The architecture integrates lightweight convolutional encoding with robust performance under adaptive event thresholding and a minimal classifier head, enabling substantial reductions in computational cost without degrading recognition fidelity. Extensive evaluations on the Smart Event Face Dataset (SEFD) and Event-Based Cro

translated_title: LiteEvent-AE：面向低延迟能量受限边缘设备的基于事件视觉的轻量级自编码器
translated_abstract: 事件视觉已成为能量感知人工智能（AI）的一种有前景的范式，提供稀疏、低延迟的视觉信号，减少冗余数据处理并支持可持续的边缘计算。然而，事件流的异步和噪声特性对传统深度学习模型构成了挑战，这些模型通常计算密集，难以在低功耗嵌入式平台上运行。本工作提出了一种紧凑且可配置的事件驱动自编码器，能够高效压缩神经形态数据，同时保留用于下游推理的基本时空结构。该架构集成了轻量级卷积编码，并在自适应事件阈值和最小分类器头下保持稳健性能，从而在不降低识别保真度的情况下大幅减少计算成本。在Smart Event Face Dataset（SEFD）和Event-Based Cro数据集上的广泛评估验证了其有效性。
tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级事件驱动自编码器，通过紧凑卷积架构和自适应阈值处理，在低功耗边缘设备上实现高效神经形态数据压缩，同时保持推理精度。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a lightweight event-driven autoencoder that efficiently compresses neuromorphic data on low-power edge devices via compact convolutional architecture and adaptive thresholding, while preserving inference accuracy.
